rationale: C20 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. Both directives use the same sequence: describe a newly created federal facility, state that it deserves an appropriate name, praise a deceased American's public service and commitment to peace or freedom, declare it fitting that the facility bear his name, and then use nearly identical operative language designating the facility and requiring that it thereafter be known and referred to by that name. C23 provides a weaker earlier naming model with similar honorific predicates and an operative renaming formula. C01 also concerns honoring a distinguished general, but it designates a dedication date rather than naming a facility and therefore supplies less of the child's machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS it is fitting that these facilities bear the name of a distinguished and revered American
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS it is fitting that the international airport being built to serve our Nation's Capital should bear the name of this distinguished American whose memory is revered
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel predicate stating that the federal facility should bear the name of a distinguished and revered American.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the late General of the Army George C. Marshall devoted his life to the service of his country and to the advancement of the cause of peace throughout the world
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the public service of John Foster Dulles, the renowned diplomat and statesman, was dedicated in large measure to the ideals of democracy and the cause of freedom and peace throughout the world
shared_material.explanation: The honoree clause follows the same structure and closely parallels the themes of public service and worldwide peace.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby designate the facilities of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration at Huntsville, Alabama, as the George C. Marshall Space Flight Center; and such facilities shall hereafter be known and referred to by that name.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate the airport now being constructed in the counties of Fairfax and Loudoun in the State of Virginia ... as the Dulles International Airport; and such airport shall hereafter be known and referred to by that name.
shared_material.explanation: The operative naming provision is nearly identical, with the type, location, and new name of the facility substituted.
